subject: Clearcrest security request: KMS change-control + rotation telemetry
messages:
From: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@clearcrest.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@clearcrest.com
Date: 2025-10-21T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request: KMS change-control artifacts + rotation telemetry

Hi Jordan,

We're kicking off Clearcrest's SOC 2 scoping and SIG collection and need a compact evidence bundle for Redwood's key management controls.

Specifically, can you provide:
- A change-control runbook for key rotation events (who signs off, ticketing workflow, thaw/ceremony steps)
- Timestamped rotation telemetry (sample covering last 90 days) with operator IDs and event hashes
- HSM attestation summary (device model, firmware, FIPS/Azure/Thales attestation report references)
- Proof that wrap/unwrap operations are signed or logged in a tamper-evident way

We prefer a single ZIP with redacted operator emails and clear mapping to rotation events in the telemetry CSV. Is that feasible by COB 10/22? If not, an interim packet with samples would be fine.

Thanks,

Amanda Lee
Security Engineer, Clearcrest Payments
amanda.lee@clearcrest.com

----
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@clearcrest.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2025-10-21T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: KMS change-control artifacts + rotation telemetry

Amanda — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Marissa (Security Ops) and Ben (Compliance lead) to assemble the packet.

High-level: Redwood supports HSM-backed key wrapping, rotation policy with change-control records in Jira and signed operator entries. We can produce a 90-day telemetry extract and a short attestation summary. We'll redact PII per your note.

Marissa / Ben — can you confirm timelines? Amanda asked for COB 10/22; if we can't deliver the full ZIP, let's provide the runbook + a 14-day telemetry sample first.

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com

----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@clearcrest.com>, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2025-10-21T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: KMS change-control artifacts + rotation telemetry

Amanda — thanks, we can do this. Quick summary of what we'll provide and next steps:

1) Change-control runbook (attachment: kms-change-control-runbook.pdf)
   - Includes ticketing flow (Jira project: KMS-OPS), approval gates, and emergency rekey procedure
   - Lists roles (Operator, Cryptographic Custodian, Security Reviewer) and required signatures

2) Rotation telemetry extract (attachment: rotation-telemetry-sample.csv)
   - CSV columns: timestamp_utc, event_type, key_id, operator_id (hashed), event_hash, ticket_id
   - We'll supply a 14-day sample now and the 90-day extract tomorrow morning (10/22)

3) HSM attestation summary (attachment: hsm-attestation-summary.txt)
   - Model: Thales Luna HSM-7, firmware v3.1.2
   - FIPS 140-2 Level 3 certified; attestation report references included in doc

4) Tamper-evidence: rotation events are immutably logged to our append-only telemetry store and cross-signed by a system CSR; the CSV includes event_hash for verification. For SIG/SOC2 detail we'll provide a description of the signing chain.

We will redact operator emails and map operator_id hashes back to role names in the runbook. Expect the initial ZIP (runbook + 14-day sample + attestation summary) within 2 hours; full 90-day extract by 10/22 10:00 PDT.

If you require signed artifacts (DocuSign or notarized attestation), please let us know and we'll route to Legal.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

----
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@clearcrest.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-10-22T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: KMS change-control artifacts + rotation telemetry

Amanda — attaching the interim package as discussed.

Attachment list:
- kms-change-control-runbook.pdf (runbook and role mapping)
- rotation-telemetry-sample.csv (UTC timestamps; operator_id hashed)
- hsm-attestation-summary.txt (device, serial, firmware, cert refs)

Notes:
- The telemetry CSV includes event_hash that maps to our audit-log Merkle tree; we can provide the Merkle root and signing cert on request.
- We redacted operator email addresses and replaced them with role tags (e.g., OPERATOR_1). If you need unobfuscated operator identities for audit, please confirm the minimum disclosure required and evidence delivery channel (SFTP/secure Share).
- For CAIQ/SIG: the runbook includes references to our SOC 2 collector and the Jira ticket examples.

Let us know if the interim packet is sufficient or if you want the full 90-day export earlier.

Best,

Ben Carter
Head of Compliance
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachment stub: clearcrest_kms_evidence_v1.zip (3 files, 1.2 MB)
